title: PerspectiveCoach: Exploring LLMs for Developer Reflection
findings: The LLM-powered tool, PerspectiveCoach, effectively supported developers in reflecting on a real-world case of online gender-based harassment against Muslim women. Participants who used the tool experienced increased self-awareness, broadened perspectives, and improved their ability to articulate nuanced ethical reasoning related to the incident.
